notes:
- Older Wilcom EMB designs can now open as stitch-coordinate previews when StitchFits can verify their stitch positions and encounters an unsupported machine-properties record. Preview-only files still require object recovery for editing and cannot be exported as machine files.
- Use More Tools to select unlocked, visible objects with the same thread color or stitch type as the selected object.
- Turn on Show future tools in More Tools to browse planned additions, including Paired Motif Fill, Program Split Outline, and specialty embroidery tools.
